The [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] utilized a secret '''safe house''' in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. From this safe house in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], a group of [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] deciphered stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] data that turned out to be the [[Death Star II plans|technical plans]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], which eventually found its way into [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hands.
